title: Summarize current Top shipment ranking quantities by exact unit
description: A user selects none/unit grouping in the product ranking designer to understand returned Top evidence by unit. Add a finite GroupBy whitelist and a server-derived group DTO with exact unit label, ranking-bucket count and signed quantity subtotal for known nonblank units, computed from fresh authorized unprojected ranking items after Top. Never derive groups from selected client columns; groups remain correct when unit/quantity columns are hidden. Blank/unknown units remain an explicitly unknown bucket with null quantity and count evidence only; do not merge case/spacing-distinct units, convert units, combine quantities across units or include money. Label every group as current Top result only, never full-date-range completeness; distinguish ranking-bucket count from unique products/documents. Designer renders unit-separated summary rows and states, preserves filters/fields/order/date/Top/grouping and permits no cross-unit grand quantity or comparative quantity chart. Existing detail Excel/PDF stay compatible; group export additions are separate follow-up increments. Development only: reuse approved nondeleted StockOut/StockOutDetails evidence, the product-sales-ranking menu and fresh current-user SalespersonDataScopeService; retain existing OperationLogMiddleware HTTP audit. Never widen ERP permissions or accept client rows/aggregates as authority. No arbitrary/model-generated SQL, direct business/table writes, new domain entities or persistence schema, schema/view/stored-procedure changes, migrations, production SQL or real database execution, production deployment, secrets/.env/config changes, irreversible operations or real browser acceptance. Keep unrelated work. Run focused in-memory unit/API/export/UI source-contract tests plus configured safe Release build/test. Any external environment acceptance that cannot run must be marked environment-blocked, never fabricated passed.
acceptance_criteria: Only none/unit grouping is accepted and groups are derived from freshly authorized server ranking items before selected-field projection; hidden columns cannot affect counts/subtotals and unknown units expose null quantity.

Designer renders exact-unit Top-only bucket counts and signed quantity subtotals with unknown-unit/empty/error states, preserving filters and group selection without cross-unit totals or revenue labels.

Focused tests cover hidden fields, separate exact units, null/blank units, negative/zero quantities, Top truncation, scope revocation and invalid GroupBy; detail Excel/PDF regressions and safe Release build/test pass.
